reviews.text: Dr. Klein has been treating my cats for 10 years. She is very attentive, caring, and gentle with animals. Highly competent and dedicated. I highly recommend her!
Dr. Anne-Marie Klein and her team are fantastic! They treat animals with gentleness, patience, and great efficiency! A loyal client since 2009... I recommend them 100%!
The staff are attentive to the well-being of the animals and always offer good advice; I recommend them without hesitation.
Excellent veterinary practice
The team has been taking care of my cat for about ten years now, and they are always incredibly gentle, attentive, and reassuring. Thank you to the veterinarians and the entire care team!
Excellent welcome, support for both the animal and the owner 😉
Dr. Klein is a fantastic veterinarian, offering excellent advice. Highly competent, extremely efficient, and incredibly kind, I recommend her 200%!
I highly recommend Dr. Anne-Marie Klein's clinic. She is patient and always takes the time to explain things clearly. And her team is always friendly and efficient.

Having owned cats since my teens, I've known the clinic for 50 years, and the arrival of Anne Marie Klein and her team over the last twenty years has been a delight. I have complete confidence in them.
I highly recommend this clinic. The vet is perfect, as are the staff.
Dr. Klein provided excellent care. Reassuring, kind, and friendly, she demonstrated great professionalism. I am very satisfied with the care my two cats received.
My cat's vet for the past 4 years. Good advice, responsive and caring.
A very good professional, very attentive and caring, with a conscientious approach.

A huge thank you to Dr. Klein, who is always so lovely, gentle, and caring. She takes excellent care of our baby, with great patience, kindness, and professionalism. You can immediately tell that the well-being of animals is her priority, and we always leave feeling reassured and completely confident.

Our baby isn't always the most cooperative patient—she has her little Maine Coon temperament!—but she is always greeted with calm and tenderness.

A truly wonderful veterinarian whom we recommend without hesitation… even if she prefers to keep her eyes wide open to keep an eye on the syringe! 😄
very good experience with Luigi

The team was very friendly, attentive, and caring. My little Eight was treated like royalty, and we were even able to get an appointment for his surgery very quickly. The surgery went very well. I recommend them without hesitation.

I always have excellent experiences during my visits with my dog, with very friendly and attentive staff. The service is prompt, with a responsive and available team, and efficient in case of emergencies.

Thank you very much.
Great clinic, the staff are friendly and the vets are always attentive, they know how to reassure us.
Nothing to say. Perfect. My cat, who terrorizes everyone, was unrecognizable in the presence of Dr. Klein.
They were very attentive, responsive, and excellent at explaining things. We are delighted to have entrusted our little Zoé to this veterinary clinic.
I highly recommend this clinic and Dr. Klein for their availability, attentiveness, advice, gentleness and kindness.
A veterinarian who listens and is kind to the animal and patient with the owner!
Clear explanations, reliable diagnosis - an innate kindness from Dr. Klein.
The best vet. Thank you to the whole team for taking care of Lizzy.
I have trusted Dr. Klein's veterinary clinics for over 20 years.
A lovely team, attentive and very dedicated to our animals.
Finally, a diagnosis has been made, whereas previous colleagues had been unsuccessful.
super

We received a very warm welcome. They are very gentle with the animals, and our usually very timid cat feels at ease during consultations thanks to this caring team.

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic.

Ms. Klein and her team of assistants are simply exceptional. I rarely leave reviews, but when a team is this wonderful, it's important to say so. This clinic doesn't just care for animals; they also support owners with genuine care. Always attentive, they take the time to answer our questions and reassure us about our concerns. Without a doubt, one of the best veterinary clinics.

I've been coming to this clinic for over 10 years, and Dr. Klein and his team have always taken excellent care of me and my cat.
They are kind and conscientious people.
Dr. Klein and his team don't hesitate to consult with colleagues (from the Maison Alfort Veterinary School and Fregis) for expert opinions. They are passionate about their work.
I highly recommend them.
Dr. Klein has been taking care of my cat for years, always with the same professionalism and empathy. His assistants are very kind and efficient. I highly recommend him.
Thank you for your gentleness and kindness towards my dogs.
Very best
Dr. Klein has been treating my animals (cats and rabbit) for over 25 years, I trust her completely and, moreover, she and her two assistants are very friendly.

Excellent veterinary clinic where my cat has been pampered for several years now!

I highly recommend it.
Very satisfied with Dr. Klein's veterinary practice in Nation, where he has been treating my cat for 6 years.

The veterinarians and staff are very attentive, responsive, and available. They are very gentle with my cat and offer advice on nutrition.

All of this makes me feel confident entrusting my pet to them for urgent issues and routine checkups. I'm delighted to have found this veterinary clinic near my home.

Fantastic clinic with lovely, attentive, and caring vets!
Thank you for everything you do!

A fantastic team, very attentive and efficient. A very warm welcome.

Thank you to everyone, and especially to Dr. Klein, for the sometimes difficult moments and anxieties we encounter with animals! We feel supported, and that's important. It's always a pleasure going to the vet... even my dog ​​loves going to the clinic; he goes all by himself :)
I've been coming here for my cat for several years and I have nothing to complain about, great practice!!

I've been going to the Vet Nation veterinary clinic for years. The team is fantastic. I adopted a small dog I found lost on the streets of Cairo; she's quite difficult to handle. So I have to have her nails trimmed by Dr. Klein, who is very patient, as are his assistants. His replacement is also very good. I highly recommend them.

Excellent clinic. Dr. Klein is very attentive to the context of the visit and is concerned with protecting the cat as much as possible (mine is very old, 16 years old) and seeks the best solution. I highly recommend this practice.

Dr. Klein and his team are wonderful with our animals. They are treated with respect and kindness.

It's truly reassuring for Dog Muns and Dads!

My dog ​​loves visiting everyone at the clinic.
Dr. Klein is truly attentive to her little patients and very kind during difficult times for their owners. I had to be with my cat during his final moments, and the doctor gave me all the time I needed to say goodbye.
I truly believe she did everything she could to ease his last days, and I am so grateful.
And I mustn't forget her assistants!

I have been a loyal customer of this veterinary clinic for many years. The staff is lovely, very professional, and reassuring. I highly recommend them! ++++++++ Thank you to Dr. Klein and Dr. Marchand, and also to Manon and Nathalie.

Dr. Klein is very kind. She takes the time to listen, explain things thoroughly, and give advice. She is gentle with the animals and their adoptive parents. She answers questions even by phone or email when a consultation isn't necessary or when you have a doubt.

The two assistants at the clinic are also very friendly and caring, which is very important, especially when you're stressed about your little companion. They take care of the animals gently and do everything they can to reassure us and help us with the process.
Very pleasant, the team has known my cats since they were kittens for 6 years, so nothing to say, a fantastic team
Expensive and very disappointing.

Excellent clinic.
The staff is wonderful, very pleasant and caring.
Dr. Klein is fantastic; he saved my kitten with the correct diagnosis from the start.
I highly recommend this veterinarian.

High professionalism, knowledge and respect for animals, gentleness and kindness, Anne-Marie Klein has been my veterinarian for two decades and she and her team have taken such good care of my little darlings, go there without hesitation!

A huge thank you to Dr. Klein, who supported us with such compassion during the loss of our cat. Thanks to her, we were able to be there for her in the best possible way during her final moments. She continues to care for our young cat today with remarkable kindness and patience. A wonderful experience that I wholeheartedly recommend.
Friendly welcome. Kindness and gentleness when handling the animals. Great respect for the sterilization of premises and medical instruments.
Attentive and very welcoming. I take my dog ​​there with complete confidence.

Top-notch veterinary clinic! The assistant was fantastic too! The reception was excellent! The arrangements were perfect! Everyone was so kind to the cats! My two cats have been patients there for several years, and I have nothing but praise; I highly recommend them! Truly lovely! Thank you again!
Dr. Klein and his team are very gentle and patient with our extremely stressed dog. Their explanations are always clear, and we feel supported.
Always perfect!
A professional team, attentive and truly caring with the animals. Their explanations are clear and the care is top-notch. I highly recommend them.
Exceptional veterinarians who give excellent advice and take the time to explain everything in detail.

The appointment was perfect, as it is every year. The injection was quick, and my cat didn't react at all. The nail trimming also went well.
My questions were answered clearly. I'm satisfied, as usual. I recommend Dr. Klein.

A very warm welcome, an excellent veterinarian, I highly recommend them. A top-notch team. I've been a loyal customer for years. When my cat Toffee was seriously ill, Dr. Klein was there for him, and when it came time to help him pass away, she took the time to ensure everything was peaceful. I have complete confidence in her care for my two cats. Manon and Nathalie are always smiling, patient, and welcoming. It's a real pleasure!
Excellent service, top-notch team!
Professionals who love their job and animals.
Avoid them at all costs! They're only after your money. From the outset, they'll recommend a €250 x-ray, not counting the consultation, medication, or blood tests!
Excellent veterinarian. I particularly appreciated her attentiveness and availability.
Excellent veterinarian, takes her time and is gentle with animals. Doesn't try to sell procedures/products at all costs. Best veterinarian
I was quite surprised that they sell pet food but not animal medications such as dewormers...
Certainly one of the best vets in Paris. Always on time, kind and gentle with my dog.

Ms. Klein is a very competent and kind veterinarian.
Her passion and love for animals are reassuring.
I highly recommend her.

A rare veterinarian who combines excellence and compassion.
A team that listens. I highly recommend them.

What can I say... There are vets... and then there's Anne-Marie.

Thank you.
20 years of caring for my French bulldogs. Complete trust. From near and far.
An exceptional veterinarian.

My cat, who had stopped eating and drinking, had a spot on the scan and couldn't even move around the house, but no, they still needed more and more tests, biopsies, etc. Another vet took pity on him and euthanized my cat. This vet just wanted to keep collecting the money.

A huge thank you to Dr. Marie Babiar and Dr. Anne-Marie Klein, who care for our two companions, Félicia and Baba, with such gentleness and professionalism.
Always attentive, with accurate diagnoses and clear explanations, they know how to reassure us as much as our cats!
Félicia and Baba feel perfectly at ease in their office, where they are warmly welcomed.

A huge thank you from the bottom of our hearts!

We recommend this office—and especially these two wonderful veterinarians—without hesitation!

Dr. Klein's team has been caring for Sky since he was born. A few weeks ago, my Staffordshire Bull Terrier was attacked by an American Akita and bitten in 14 places. Dr. Klein saw him immediately and treated him with her characteristic gentleness and kindness. She checked in with him that same evening to make sure he was okay.

A huge thank you for the care, advice, and support. You and your assistants are an incredible team.

The opening hours are incorrect. It says they open at 2 PM, but they're closed.
When you're the most expensive place in the neighborhood, you should show a little more consideration for your customers.
My two dogs 🐕 only trust this vet who has been treating us for a very long time. A big thank you! …

We paid €500 to learn that our kitten was fine.

It's been three months now, but I still feel like I was ripped off.

Our kitten had several eye infections. Dr. Klein repeatedly emphasized the urgency of the situation and the potential risk, even mentioning a life-threatening danger. She performed several blood tests without informing me beforehand of the very high cost of these analyses, only to finally tell us that our kitten had no illness.

It was my husband—who isn't a veterinarian—who solved the problem by simply changing the litter product, which was causing these eye reactions.

I feel that they deliberately played on my fear and pressure, emphasizing the risk to our cat's life, in order to push me to accept all the proposed procedures, without even considering simpler or less expensive solutions.

It worked once, but we won't be going back to that practice. Even though Dr. Babine, who had been treating our kitten for several months, was friendly and competent. The receptionists are also pleasant and kind.

I've known Dr. Klein for 16 years. Her assistants are wonderful!

She has always taken excellent care of my cats. She was an immense support during the last eight months of my youngest cat's life.

Today, I'm reunited with two kittens. No one else is taking care of them!
It's more than just a veterinary clinic! Even with the other clients, it's like a family! The atmosphere is warm and professional.

For nearly fifteen years, I have entrusted the health of my dogs to Dr. Klein. Beyond her professional skills, her human qualities are exceptional, both towards the animals and their owners. Thank you, Madam, to you and your wonderful team.

I came to this veterinary clinic in July on a recommendation for my cat's booster vaccinations before a trip to Europe (Madeira, Portugal). The vet told me I had to come back 10 days before my departure to get a Health Certificate.
This certificate cost me 90 euros in addition to the initial consultation.
To my surprise, I inquired and discovered that a Health Certificate is not required for travel within the European Union, but only for travel outside the EU (see the relevant article below).
Furthermore, Ms. Klein asked me to come back to get a second certificate for my trip to Ibiza (Spain) a month later, even though the certificate is only valid for ten days. That's 180 euros charged unnecessarily! Was this intentional or incompetent? Madam, you shouldn't let commerce replace veterinary care!

Dr. Klein and the entire team are wonderful, kind, and patient.

They love what they do.

Dr. Klein and the entire team are wonderful, kind, and patient-friendly.

They truly love what they do.
Veterinarian to recommend

I have complete confidence in Ms. Klein and her assistants, who have always been incredibly caring towards my cat. I received excellent advice to ensure I only undertook the bare minimum necessary for my pet's well-being, and I am very satisfied with the ease of access and scheduling appointments.
Fantastic vet with wonderful assistants. Professional and qualified, my little dog has always been very well cared for and pampered. I highly recommend them.
A vet who is always attentive, very professional and competent. My dog ​​loves her too, which says a lot.
Very friendly and professional veterinarian.

Dr. Anne-Marie Klein is exceptional!

She is highly skilled medically, a great listener, and an extraordinary human being.
She was recommended to me by a friend, and although she lives far away, she is now my cat's primary care physician.
She knows of leading clinics for serious cases and closely monitors my cat's condition. She also gives excellent advice and cares for your pet like no one else, demonstrating genuine empathy for us humans. She doesn't just focus on the technical aspects of animal suffering; quite the opposite!

I highly recommend her; you can entrust your pets to her without hesitation!
I am deeply grateful to her for caring for my cat who is battling cancer.
Perfect.

Perfect team.
Highly recommended.
Top-notch vet clinic! Thank you for everything, great team!
Very professional welcome, helpful staff, great kindness from the whole team.
Always very professional, the clinic is spacious and the vets are great. I recommend them.
I've been a loyal client of this clinic for 11 years. My cocker spaniel has always been well cared for with gentleness and attention. The team is fantastic! I highly recommend them.
Excellent 5-star clinic, my cat is always very well taken care of.

The vets and assistants are fantastic!

Patience and expertise. And a smile to boot. In short, I love them and highly recommend them!

I don't understand if this clinic treats our animals or makes them even sicker. Three times I've taken my dog ​​there, and three times I've picked him up even sicker than before, vomiting and infested with fleas! And when I try to understand what's going on, the receptionist (the brunette) cuts me off, claiming she has to close because she's going on summer vacation. Not to mention the medical procedures performed without my authorization and, of course, billed: apparently, my dog ​​wouldn't cooperate (which surprises me greatly) during the blood test, so instead of waiting for me to calm him down, they preferred to give him a €30 tranquilizer.
